title: Turkish Prawn Borek
description: A flavorful and crispy Turkish-style borek filled with succulent prawns. Serve as an appetizer or snack.
instructions: Unroll the borek pastry and cut into 4 equal pieces.
In a bowl, mix together prawns, feta cheese, parsley, salt, and pepper.
Place a tablespoon of the prawn mixture onto the center of each pastry piece.
Brush the edges with the beaten egg and fold the pastry to form a triangle.
Press the edges to seal and use a fork to crimp.
Place the borek on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the tops with the remaining egg and bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
